company.shortDescription: Palmstreet is a community-obsessed live shopping platform.
company.description: Palmstreet is a community-obsessed live shopping platform connecting over 2 million passionate collectors and sellers. Starting with plants in 2020, Palmstreet has evolved to include handmade crafts, vintage decor, and unique finds from talented sellers worldwide.

productsAndServices.description: A live-commerce platform where sellers stream products, interact with viewers, and complete purchases through live auctions and sales.

productsAndServices.description: An online marketplace with listings for collectible and specialty goods, including rare plants, aquatics, reptiles, crystals, jewelry, fashion, coins, and designer toys.
